violence.details: Combat with traditional Swazi weapons (Umshiza fighting stick, spear). Cattle raids depict conflict. No gore. No dismemberment. Historical battles depicted with period-accurate weapons.

sexual_content.descriptor: No sexual content. Lobola (cattle bride price) is a cultural/economic mechanic only.

themes.descriptor: Historical subjugation, colonial violence, depiction of 19th-century Eswatini political crises. Presented from Swazi perspective with historical accuracy.
themes.positive_note: Cultural ceremonies (Incwala, Umhlanga Reed Dance) depicted respectfully with consultation context.
